faqs.question: What courses are offered at Soni Ke Nakhray Music and Dance Academy?
faqs.answer: We offer a variety of courses in classical and contemporary dance styles, vocal training, instrumental music, and performance workshops.

faqs.question: Do you have classes for all age groups?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have programs for children, teens, and adults, suitable for beginners as well as advanced learners.

faqs.question: Can I take a trial class before enrolling?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer trial classes so you can experience the teaching style and class environment before making a commitment.

faqs.question: What is the duration and frequency of classes?
faqs.answer: Most classes are held 1-2 times a week, and course durations range from monthly sessions to year-long programs.

faqs.question: Do you conduct stage performances or competitions?
faqs.answer: Yes, students regularly perform at academy-organized events and participate in local and national competitions.

faqs.question: Are online classes available?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer online classes for both music and dance for students who prefer to learn from home.

faqs.question: Do I need to bring my own instruments?
faqs.answer: For initial classes, we provide instruments. Students enrolled in long-term courses are encouraged to have their own.

faqs.question: Is there a registration or admission fee?
faqs.answer: Yes, a one-time registration fee applies at the time of admission. Fee details are available on our website or at the front desk.

faqs.question: Do you offer certification upon course completion?
faqs.answer: Yes, students who complete the full course receive a certificate from Soni Ke Nakhray Music and Dance Academy.

faqs.question: How can I contact the academy for inquiries?
faqs.answer: You can call us at (123) 456-7890 or email info@sonikenakhray.com for any questions or registration help.
